title: Fibroblast-enriched senescence-associated transcription and measurement-context-dependent FAP–matrix covariation in colorectal cancer: reproducibility archive
description: Version 2.0.0 supports the PLOS ONE v7.1 manuscript with patient-level single-cell localization analyses, FAP-specific cluster-bootstrap models, matched-null controls, target-purged bulk composition sensitivity, proteomic triangulation, a three-cohort spatial generalizability stress test, lowercase-panel publication figures, source tables, scripts and integrity records. Public raw matrices are not redistributed.
